primary_intent: Ensure there is exactly one booked Appointment for patient Tomasz Wren (DOB 1966-01-30) with practitioner Dr Ama Osei at 2026-11-17T14:00:00Z–14:30:00Z, with both participants accepted, using the Medplum app. A reasonable user would be inflexible about the correct patient, time window, status, and participants; they would be flexible about output narration format as long as the record is correctly saved and reported.
reasoning: Nitpicks: (1) The agent’s textual reply included extra narration instead of reporting only the four fields; this affects formatting, not the appointment’s correctness. (2) No on-screen verification of the Practitioner record for Dr Ama Osei was shown; this is an evidence gap but not proof of an error. (3) The agent did not visibly demonstrate a targeted pre-check for an existing matching appointment; however, the final list shows only one appointment on the server. Critical issues: None shown—there is no evidence of a wrong patient, wrong time, wrong status, or duplicate creation. The JSON used to create the Appointment has the exact required fields (status booked; start 2026-11-17T14:00:00Z; end 2026-11-17T14:30:00Z; two participants with status accepted). Screenshots visually confirm the correct Patient (Tomasz Wren, DOB 1966-01-30) and that exactly one Appointment exists with the created ID. Critical-Point decision: This task has a binding save/creation CP with user permission. The agent crossed the CP and completed the binding action correctly—thus the first SUCCESS rule fires. Outcome assessment: Based on the final Appointment list (1–1 of 1) and the creation JSON, the appointment was created exactly once with the required fields. The patient identity is visually confirmed, and while the practitioner identity is not shown on-screen, there is no contradictory evidence; the created resource references a Practitioner and sets both participant statuses to accepted. The RESULT line correctly reports the created Appointment ID. Overall, the user’s primary intent—to have exactly one correct booked Appointment at the specified time—appears satisfied.
